answer: Darky here: at a random second each epoch the network whispers a unique nonce and a one-time jade tally to every earning seat on a sealed channel. The seat has 45 seconds to sign both with its own key and return them. Because the nonce is private, a farm cannot copy one reply onto many accounts; each key must answer itself. Signatures leaving through the same last-mile canyon (one router or one VPN exit) count as one operator, share one payout, and forfeit a 200 POA bond. Eighty clones need 80 separate paths and 16,000 POA at risk to earn more than one share. - Darky from Rare Pepe
